cycle_decision.decision: Abandon exact Markov closure on hump positions/local edge shape; continue Cycle 2 with a nonlocal boundary-layer trace.

cycle_decision.surviving_state: Competition trace K*u or a controlled window profile.

outcome: Equal complete local germs at a regular density level can have different exact level velocities because the top-hat competition trace is not locally determined.
